description: Read-only XRPL Payment Channel lookup for one account. `account` is the required XRPL classic account address; by default, the lookup returns channels where that account is the source. Use `destination_account` to filter channels by destination, `ledger_index` to pin the lookup to a validated ledger, and `marker` to continue pagination; `limit` caps returned channels and defaults to 200. The result lists Payment Channel entries without modifying the ledger, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for PaymentChannelCreate/Fund/Claim inspection; use n9t2_xrpl_list_account_objects for generic account ledger objects instead.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose Payment Channels should be listed.
account.title: Account

destination_account.description: Optional destination account filter. When supplied, return channels whose destination is this account.
destination_account.title: Destination Account

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Maximum number of Payment Channel entries to return. Default is 200.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_channels
